_twist: microsoft-ai uses a dense enterprise UHF nav (54px height, multi-tier dropdowns, icon fonts). Twist: distill to a minimal 3-zone letterpress bar — wordmark left in Cormorant, sparse link cluster center in Inter uppercase at 11px/0.12em tracking, CTA ghost button right. Lose the dropdowns entirely. Scroll behavior: transparent over hero, converts to opaque warm surface on scroll down with a fine 1px border-bottom. Underline-draw hover, no background pills.

scrollTransition._note: Nav links remain dark (#2c2318) in both states — only bg changes

dropdown._note: No dropdowns — navigation is intentionally flat and sparse

mobileMenu.animation: clip-path iris: circle(0% at 50% 50%) → circle(150% at 50% 50%)

characterDescription: A minimal three-zone letterpress bar: Cormorant Garamond wordmark at left, sparse Inter uppercase links center (11px, 0.12em tracking), ghost CTA right. Transparent over hero, converts to warm linen (#f9f7f4) surface with fine 1px bone border on scroll. Hover affordance is a left-origin underline draw — no fills, no pills, no dropdowns. The nav communicates restraint and archival precision over navigational comprehensiveness.
